rows.en:
(Let's see...
The year the Macross had its launch ceremony......
Huh? What year was it again?)
What, you can't even answer a question like that?
The answer is 2009.

Oh, right, right, it was 2009.
Then what about this question...
For that one, you see...
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders; she starts explaining.

rows.en:
Thanks!
I finished my homework thanks to you, Pinon-chan.

Something like this is a piece of cake for me.
If there's another question you don't get,
come ask me.
(Pinon-chan really is a child genius...)

(But Pinon-chan's the one who assigned
this homework... Was it really okay
to have her solve it for me?)

(Let's see...
The year the Macross had its launch ceremony......
Huh? What year was it again?)
What, you can't even answer a question like that?
rows.notes: Pinon, female scene; same as c19124.

rows.en:
Oh, right, right, it was 2009.
Then what about this question...

Thanks!
I finished my homework thanks to you, Pinon-chan.
(Pinon-chan really is a child genius...)

(But Pinon-chan's the one who assigned
this homework... Was it really okay
to have her solve it for me?)

(Okay, I've finished my lunch.
What should I do with the rest of lunch break...?)
(Huh? Pinon-chan's still eating her lunch.)

Pinon-chan, you have to eat properly,
or you won't grow up big.

What is it, \p?!
Popping up out of nowhere and treating me
like a ch...!
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. Cut off as she chokes on her food (next row).

rows.en: Gk!! Khh!

That's what you get for talking with your
mouth full. Here, have some tea.
Th-thank you...
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. sumanai here thanks the player for the tea; 'thank you' reads better than 'sorry' before the next line.

rows.en: Wait, that's HOOOOT~~~!!

Becaushe of you, \p,
I burned my tongue, din't I...
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. Japanese slurs ja nai ka as 'hya nya i ka' from the burned tongue; rendered with a lisp.

rows.en:
Sorry.
I had no idea you were that bad with hot stuff...
rows.notes: PLAYER, both genders. nekojita = can't handle hot food or drink.

rows.en: Shheesh...

(Pinon-chan loves gratin,
but she can't handle anything hot...)

(Okay, I've finished my lunch.
What should I do with the rest of lunch break...?)
(Huh? Pinon-chan's still eating her lunch.)

Pinon-chan, you have to eat properly,
or you won't grow up big.

That's what you get for talking with your
mouth full. Here, have some tea.

(Pinon-chan loves gratin,
but she can't handle anything hot...)
Hup!
rows.notes: Pinon jumping at the vending machine button.

rows.en: Hah!
Huuup!!

(Hm? What's Pinon-chan doing
in front of the vending machine?)

Dammit~, why is the juice I want to drink
always up high on the vending machine?!
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. kuso kept at full strength.

rows.en:
(She's struggling because she can't reach
the button...)

Pinon-chan, what do you want to drink?
I'll press the button for you.
Ugh, \p...

I don't need to borrow your hand or anything!
If I get serious, this is nothing!!
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. She jumps and hits the wrong button (coffee).

rows.en: H-hey... Did you really want coffee?

O-of course I did!
I love coffee!!

I-it's true!
I love it, I tell you!! J-just watch~!
It's so bitter~~!!

Pinon-chan...
I'll buy you a new juice, okay...?
Uuu~~

(Pinon-chan, you could at least drop
the stubborn act at a time like this...)

(Hm? What's Pinon-chan doing
in front of the vending machine?)

(She's struggling because she can't reach
the button...)

Pinon-chan, what do you want to drink?
I'll press the button for you.

Pinon-chan...
I'll buy you a new juice, okay...?
(Huh? That's unusual...)
Pinon-chan, look over there.

See, there's a snake over there.
You don't usually see one in a place like this.
Hii...!
Kyaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!

Sorry, Pinon-chan...
I had no idea you couldn't stand reptiles...
rows.notes: PLAYER, both genders. nigate = can't stand / not good with.

rows.en:
I-it's not that I can't stand them!
I just can't bring myself to like them, that's all!

(Isn't that exactly what "can't stand them"
means...?)
rows.notes: PLAYER, both genders. Wordplay kept on 'can't stand'.

rows.en:
Anyway!
Don't you DARE tell anyone
that I screamed! Got it?
G-good, as long as you understand...

(I can't believe Pinon-chan got that scared...
She really can't stand reptiles.)

See, there's a snake over there.
You don't usually see one in a place like this.

(I can't believe Pinon-chan got that scared...
She really can't stand reptiles.)

uncertain: c19146 / c19148: Pinon's burned-tongue slur (hya nya i ka, myattaku) rendered as an English lisp ('Becaushe', 'din't I', 'Shheesh'), not as cat-speak 'nya'.
c19144: sumanai read as thanks for the tea ('Th-thank you...') rather than an apology.
